title: DEFINITELY wash before using
text: DEFINITELY wash before using. This was a disappointment. VERY thin, and by very, I mean nearly transparent. The entire thing weighs only a few ounces, about as much as a T-shirt. Seriously, it's that light. Not going to do much in terms of trapping heat or wrapping you up - this is so lightweight, you cannot even feel the weight of it on you. It shedded fluff everywhere on day one. I washed it and you should have SEEN the lint trap in the dryer. Half the blanket disassembled itself and ended up in the trap. Which, of course, further reduced the weight and effectiveness of the blanket. Spend a bit more and get a good one. This is worthless.
